footer.disclaimer: Education, not medical advice. Low FODMAP is a short, guided diet. Your own tolerance after reintroduction matters most.
footer.notAffiliated: Not affiliated with Monash University or FODMAP Friendly.

food.title: Is {name} low FODMAP?
food.phasesText: This guide is for the elimination phase (2–6 weeks). Then you reintroduce one FODMAP group at a time, and keep what you tolerate.
food.report: Spotted a mistake or something out of date? Tell us. We aim to fix factual errors within two working days.
food.sliderHelp: Drag to see how the answer changes with the amount.

doctor.title: See a doctor first if
items: you see blood in your stool or it turns black
symptoms are new and you're over 45–50
you have a family history of bowel cancer, coeliac disease or IBD
doctor.note: These need checking before you change your diet. A FODMAP-trained dietitian can guide the diet itself.

checker.mealHelp: Add 2–5 foods with amounts. We add up each FODMAP group as an estimate.
checker.estimate: Estimate from each food's lab data. Stacking hasn't been lab-tested as a meal.
